ns2:course.label: Intro Asian American Theatre
ns2:course.description: Introduction to Asian American theatre, with emphasis on theatre companies, actors, playwrights, and audiences, through the reading of major dramatic works, examining production histories, and viewing Asian American performances and film. Same as AAS 260.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Non-Western Cultures, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
